headline: Teacher dies after falling from rickshaw during snatching near parliament
summary: Ronjina Parvin, a primary school headteacher from Bogura, died after being pulled from her rickshaw by motorcycle-borne snatchers in Dhaka.
details: A woman teacher died after being pulled from a rickshaw by snatchers near the South Plaza of the National Parliament building in Dhaka.
The deceased, Ronjina Parvin, was the headteacher of Bagbari Balika Government Primary School in Bogura.
Parvin had traveled from Bogura to Dhaka to visit a doctor at Islamia Eye Hospital in the Farmgate area.
After arriving at the Gabtoli bus terminal in the early morning, she took a rickshaw to the hospital.
As she reached the South Plaza of the Parliament building, motorcycle-borne snatchers pulled her bag, causing her to fall and suffer a severe head injury.
She was rushed to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared her dead on arrival.
The Tejgaon Division Deputy Commissioner of Police, Ibn Mizan, stated that police are working to identify the motorcycle and the suspects involved.
Police officials expressed hope that the arrests of the perpetrators will be place shortly.

headline: Up to Tk2 lakh reward for information on looted, illegal arms
summary: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed announced a special police unit to recover stolen weapons and cash rewards for informants.
details: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed announced the formation of a special police unit to recover looted and illegal weapons across the country.
During a briefing at the Police Auditorium in Rajarbagh, he stated that informants providing helpful information will be rewarded between Tk 10,000 and Tk 2 lakh.
caption:
Get up to Tk 2 lakh for reporting looted weapons. The Home Minister has launched a special police unit to recover illegal arms.

Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed announced the formation of a special police unit to recover looted and illegal weapons across the country.

During a briefing at the Police Auditorium in Rajarbagh, he stated that informants providing helpful information will be rewarded between Tk 10,000 and Tk 2 lakh.
